question.text: An Overnight MIBOR futures contract has an operating range of +/-5% of the base rate. If the base rate is 6.50%, what is the allowable trading range?

explanation.text: The Logic: +/-5% of 6.50% = 6.50 x 0.05 = 0.325%. Lower bound = 6.50 - 0.325 = 6.175%. Upper bound = 6.50 + 0.325 = 6.825%. The Trap: 1.50% to 11.50% adds and subtracts 5 percentage points. 6.45% to 6.55% uses 0.05 absolute. 6.00% to 7.00% uses 0.50 absolute. Note: "+/-5% of base rate" means 5% of the rate value, not 5 percentage points. Per the workbook, Overnight MIBOR futures use a notional principal of Rs. 5 crores for one month — use that figure when a stem also asks for contract value.
